jitter_protocol: Independent seed+1 uniform event offsets; half-width min(0.06 s, 0.2 periods); nominal cadence labels remain generator settings. Noise seed/channel unchanged; actual perturbed centers are truth.
limitations: Gaussian pulse acceleration surrogate with known event centers. Not measured walking, participant validation or clinical fall-risk prediction.

motion_protocol.definition: Add amplitude*sin(2*pi*frequency*(t-start))*sin(pi*(t-start)/(end-start))**2 on [start,end), zero elsewhere. Original event times and paired noise remain unchanged. Teaching motion surrogate, not measured biomechanics; reconstruct full-precision hashes from generator/config.

noise_replicate_protocol: Ten predeclared noise seeds seed+1000 through seed+1009 per cadence/noise cell, fixed regular event times and detector. Within-cell noise-only sensitivity, not subject/population uncertainty or confidence intervals. Seed realizations are paired across cells; do not pool cells as independent samples. Exact signals regenerate from config and each stored seed. Each replicate also adds the fixed motion burst to the same signal; original-minus-motion F1 summaries preserve pairing and may be negative. No confidence intervals or subject-population inference.
signal_gap_protocol: Base regular-timing signals have samples in [0.4*duration,0.5*duration) replaced by constant 1 g, timestamps retained. This is a finite flattening surrogate, not real missing-value handling. Reproduce full-precision masked signals from the generator/config and stated mask. Base data.csv is rounded and does not reproduce full-precision signal hashes. Nominal references include gap centers; present references exclude them. Boundary/filter peaks can match nominal slots without recovering signal.
summary_interpretation: interval_cv_percent retains population SD (ddof=0). sample_interval_cv_percent uses sample SD (ddof=1) only with >=2 intervals; interval_count makes sample size explicit. Neither estimates clinical fall risk.
